changelog: Navigation icons and labels now form a centered, compact group when Show Navigation Labels is enabled.
Preserved native system-bar insets, bar height, selection and transparent live-content behavior.
Replaced dramatic transition styles with fade-through, short directional shifts, rise and subtle settle motion.
Settings forward/back transitions share the same motion profiles, reverse correctly and respect reduced motion.
Navigation feedback is finite and restrained; legacy bounce, spin and perpetual pulse settings map to the new styles.
ATTENTION: Update through dcext or the CS3M Updater, then fully restart CloudStream.
ATTENTION: Default and None remain unchanged; physical-phone visual confirmation is pending.
message: v737 - Balanced navigation labels and redesigned transitions
